addon.name: ATC-AI-Traffic
addon.short-description: Realistic worldwide ATC advisories, enhanced default FlightGear traffic, a generic AI-traffic generator, and optional live adsb.lol traffic.
addon.long-description:
ATC-AI-Traffic adds a cooperative, read-only ATC advisory layer and realistic AI traffic behavior on top of FlightGear's built-in traffic.
Three interchangeable traffic sources (property /sim/atc-ai-traffic/source): * fg-traffic (default): enhance aircraft created by FlightGear's own Traffic Manager with proximity sound and ATC advisories, without touching or moving them. * generator: spawn generic worldwide traffic in a ring around you and steer it realistically through the AI flight controls. * adsb: OPTIONAL live real-world traffic from the free adsb.lol API.
Aircraft are rendered as FlightGear AI objects and driven through controls/flight/* so turns, climbs and descents use the realistic AI flight model. A Canvas radar plus an advisory log are available from the Tools > ATC-AI-Traffic menu. Ships procedurally synthesised radio, engine, gear and proximity sounds.
